en.headline: Three vehicles collide on Cheung Tung Road near Sunny Bay
en.dek: Police said a taxi driver was briefly trapped after a light goods vehicle, a private car and a taxi collided in Tung Chung on Sunday afternoon.

zh.headline: 東涌翔東路三車相撞 的士司機一度被困
zh.dek: 警方表示，星期日下午一輛輕型貨車、私家車及的士在翔東路一帶相撞，的士司機受傷並一度被困，其後獲救。

en.headline: Observatory says cold-front showers may reach the estuary
en.dek: A cold front over Guangdong was moving south on Sunday evening, and the Observatory said related showers and thunderstorms could affect the Pearl River estuary within two to three hours.

zh.headline: 天文台：冷鋒南下 驟雨雷暴或影響珠江口
zh.dek: 天文台表示，廣東一道冷鋒星期日傍晚正向南移動，相關驟雨及雷暴未來兩、三小時或影響珠江口，部分地區雨勢較大。

en.headline: Golden Week day four passes 616,000 crossings by 4pm
en.dek: The Immigration Department recorded about 337,500 arrivals and 278,000 departures by 4pm on Sunday, with Lok Ma Chau Spur Line the busiest inbound point.

zh.headline: 黃金周第四日截至下午四時逾61萬人次出入境
zh.dek: 入境處表示，星期日下午四時前錄得約33萬7500人次入境、約27萬8000人次出境，落馬洲支線是入境最繁忙管制站。

en.headline: Northeast New Territories landfill extension opens fully
en.dek: The Environmental Protection Department said the extension began full operation on Sunday and will replace the existing site, due to close later this year.

zh.headline: 新界東北堆填區擴建部分今日全面啟用
zh.dek: 環保署宣布，擴建部分星期日全面啟用，接替原有堆填區；原址將於本年稍後停運並進行修復。

en.headline: Hong Kong ends Asian Games with 11 golds and 54 medals
en.dek: The delegation finished with 11 gold, 19 silver and 24 bronze, its best gold and medal totals at an Asian Games, RTHK reported.

zh.headline: 港隊亞運閉幕合計11金54牌 金銀銅皆歷屆最多
zh.dek: 港台報道，代表團今屆以11金19銀24銅作結，合共54面獎牌，金牌及獎牌總數同為歷屆亞運最佳。

en.headline: Jockey Club to pay HK$37.5 million in Asian Games bonuses
en.dek: More than 110 medallists will share the sum under the club's athlete incentive scheme, HK$5 million more than after Hangzhou.

zh.headline: 馬會向亞運獎牌得主發放3750萬元獎金
zh.dek: 港台報道，超過110名獎牌得主將透過賽馬會優秀運動員獎勵計劃分享這筆獎金，較杭州亞運多500萬元。

en.headline: Chan says IPO haul tops HK$388 billion in nine months
en.dek: The financial secretary also said Golden Week's first three days brought more than 732,000 mainland visitor arrivals, up about 8.4%.

zh.headline: 陳茂波：首九個月新股集資逾3880億元
zh.dek: 財政司長在網誌指，集資額按年多一倍並超越去年全年；黃金周首三日內地旅客逾73.2萬人次，按年增約8.4%。

en.headline: Hiker injured by monkey at Shing Mun Reservoir
en.dek: Police were called at 11:16am after a woman in her 30s was hurt on the hand while hiking near Pineapple Dam and taken to Yan Chai Hospital.

zh.headline: 城門水塘行山女子遭猴子傷手送院
zh.dek: 警方上午11時16分接報，一名30餘歲女子在菠蘿壩附近行山時手部受傷流血，清醒送往仁濟醫院。

en.headline: Thunderstorm warning extended until 5pm, Observatory says
en.dek: The warning issued at 1:03pm remains in force until 5pm, after lightning over the New Territories and isolated showers.

zh.headline: 雷暴警告延長至下午5時 新界有閃電
zh.dek: 天文台下午2時31分的天氣報告指，下午1時03分發出的雷暴警告有效至下午5時，新界東西早前錄得閃電。

en.headline: Observatory outlook: cooler mornings, then a drier work week
en.dek: A northeast monsoon replenishment is due tonight, with showers easing and mornings turning slightly cooler before clearer, drier days later in the week.

zh.headline: 天文台展望：本周早上稍涼 後期轉晴乾燥
zh.dek: 東北季候風補充今晚抵達廣東沿岸，未來數日風勢較大、驟雨減少，早上稍涼，本周後期大致天晴乾燥。

en.headline: Sun says foreign carer trial to start in second half of next year
en.dek: The labour chief said the first intake would be several hundred people, each trained for more than 150 hours.

zh.headline: 孫玉菡：外籍家居照顧員擬明年下半年試行
zh.dek: 勞福局局長說初期引入數百人，須在原居地接受逾150小時培訓。

en.headline: Hong Kong Airlines Okinawa flight returns after gear alert
en.dek: HX676 landed safely with no injuries, and the airline arranged another flight for 160 passengers.

zh.headline: 香港航空沖繩航班疑起落架未收妥折返
zh.dek: HX676安全降落，機上無人受傷，航空公司已為160名旅客安排替代航班。

en.headline: Observatory issues afternoon thunderstorm warning
en.dek: The warning was issued at 1:03pm and set to last until 3pm, with localised thunderstorms expected.

zh.headline: 天文台下午一時發出雷暴警告
zh.dek: 警告有效至下午三時，預料本港有局部地區雷暴。

en.headline: eMPF opens one-stop account enquiry from Monday
en.dek: Members, authorised persons and estate handlers will be able to request trustee names, account numbers and balances in one application.

zh.headline: 積金易明起推一站式帳戶查詢
zh.dek: 計劃成員、獲授權人士及處理遺產人士可一次申請查閱受託人、帳戶號碼及結餘。

en.headline: Hui leaves Monday night for Italy metals conference
en.dek: The financial services secretary will attend a precious metals meeting in Sorrento and visit Swiss gold refineries before returning on Thursday.

zh.headline: 許正宇周一晚出發 赴意大利出席貴金屬會議
zh.dek: 財庫局局長將到索倫托出席全球貴金屬會議，並到瑞士參觀黃金精煉廠，周四返港。

en.headline: AFCD lists eight farm and fishery tours from November
en.dek: Places are HK$300 each, for ages six and above, and can be booked only at a Tseung Kwan O fair on 10 and 11 October.

zh.headline: 漁護署下月起辦八個漁農體驗團
zh.dek: 每位300元，6歲或以上可參加，只限10月10及11日在將軍澳東港城博覽現場報名。

en.headline: Driver freed after car moves outside Prince Edward bar
en.dek: A 29-year-old man suffered a minor right-knee injury after he was trapped between a BYD and a Volkswagen in Sai Yeung Choi Street North.

zh.headline: 太子酒吧外私家車駛前 司機被夾輕傷
zh.dek: 29歲男司機在西洋菜北街被夾在比亞迪與福士之間數分鐘，右膝輕傷清醒送院。

en.headline: Woman reports HK$21.5 million lost in crypto scam
en.dek: Police said a 60-year-old woman reported transfers between April and September after a site asked for a deposit to prove her account was clean.

zh.headline: 六旬婦報稱虛擬貨幣投資被騙2150萬
zh.dek: 警方指她周六報案，4月至9月多次轉帳，平台曾要求交保證金以證明帳戶未涉洗黑錢。

en.headline: Immigration expects Sunday land-border inbound peak
en.dek: The Immigration Department forecast about 586,000 land-border arrivals today, the busiest inbound day in its Golden Week plan.

zh.headline: 入境處料周日為陸路入境高峰
zh.dek: 入境處預計今日陸路入境約58.6萬人次，是國慶黃金周計劃中最繁忙的入境日。

en.headline: Kai Tak Hospital family clinic bookings open this morning
en.dek: The Hospital Authority said patients can book the new Kai Tak family medicine clinic from this morning, ahead of Monday's opening.

zh.headline: 啟德醫院家庭醫學診所今早開始預約
zh.dek: 醫管局表示，啟德醫院家庭醫學綜合中心周一開診，市民由今早起可經HA Go或電話預約偶發性疾病診症。

en.headline: Cultural Centre foyer hosts free Asia+ music-box show
en.dek: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department is listing the Asia+ Festival exhibition at the Cultural Centre foyer, with free entry.

zh.headline: 文化中心大堂展出亞藝無疆音樂盒裝置
zh.dek: 康文署今日節目表列出亞藝無疆專題展覽在香港文化中心大堂展出，免費入場。

en.headline: Man reports HK$800,000 taken from Beacon Peak flat
en.dek: Police said a 28-year-old man reported signs of a search at a flat on Yin Ping Road on Saturday night, with jewellery and cash missing.

zh.headline: 筆架山豪宅單位報失約80萬元財物
zh.dek: 警方指周六約晚上9時接獲28歲男子報案，延坪道Beacon Peak單位有搜掠痕跡，失去珠寶及現金，暫未有人被捕。

en.headline: Science Museum food-science show runs through 28 October
en.dek: The museum and the French consulate opened the ground-floor exhibition on 1 October as part of a French science festival, the Hong Kong Economic Journal reported.

zh.headline: 科學館「創味盤中餐」展至10月28日
zh.dek: 香港經濟日報報道，科學館與法國駐港澳總領事館合作，地下展覽廳由10月1日起展出，屬法國科學節節目。

en.headline: One Stanley seller says it will cooperate with probe
en.dek: K Wise Limited said late on Saturday it would remedy the Stanley house if the inquiry finds fault, citing the department's view of no obvious danger.

zh.headline: One Stanley賣方稱配合屋宇署調查
zh.dek: 建灝附屬公司堅維有限公司周六深夜發聲明，指會核實資料並協助署方，若查實有失誤會補救及追究責任。

en.headline: Three Hong Kong riders in Asian Games jumping final
en.dek: RTHK said the Nagoya Games close on Sunday night, with the last two golds still to be decided in show jumping.

zh.headline: 亞運今晚閉幕 三名港隊騎手出戰場地障礙決賽
zh.dek: 港台報道，名古屋亞運周日晚上閉幕，最後兩面金牌留待馬術場地障礙賽產生。

en.headline: Cultural Centre moonlit lanterns stay lit through 11 October
en.dek: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department's free piazza installation by Stickyline lights from 6:30pm to 11pm, Thursdays to Sundays.

zh.headline: 文化中心中秋光影裝置展至10月11日
zh.dek: 康文署社區節目辦事處表示，尖沙咀文化中心露天廣場裝置周四至日晚上6時半至11時亮燈，免費入場。

en.headline: About 600 visited Po Pin Chau section on Saturday
en.dek: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department said numbers were lower than expected after morning rain warnings, and bookings through Tuesday are full.

zh.headline: 周六約600人到破邊洲段 日至二預約已滿
zh.dek: 漁護署表示，受早上市況影響，到訪人數較預期低，黃金周10月4日至6日預約已額滿。

en.headline: Golden Week day three passes 1.02 million crossings by 9pm
en.dek: The Immigration Department said more than 1.02 million people had crossed Hong Kong's control points by 9pm on Saturday, the third day of the mainland holiday.

zh.headline: 黃金周第三天截至晚上9時逾102萬人次出入境
zh.dek: 入境處表示，周六晚上9時，本港各管制站累計出入境已超過102萬人次，為內地國慶黃金周第三天。

en.headline: Palace Museum exhibition on Qing court workshops stays open
en.dek: The Hong Kong Palace Museum opened a show on the imperial workshops of the Qing court on 30 September, and it remains on view in Gallery 5 over the holiday weekend.

zh.headline: 故宮文化博物館清代造辦處設計展假期繼續開放
zh.dek: 香港故宮文化博物館與北京故宮博物院合辦的造辦處設計展，9月30日於5號展廳開放，國慶假期周末仍在展出。

en.headline: Customs log 627 Hotstone Yoga complaints worth about HK$7 million
en.dek: Reports of unused prepaid classes have risen from 381 cases and about HK$4.07 million recorded by Friday afternoon.

zh.headline: 海關接627宗岩盤瑜伽舉報 涉款約700萬元
zh.dek: 星島報道，截至周六下午6時，舉報由周五約381宗、約407萬元增至627宗，涉預繳課程未能兌現。

en.headline: Squash team home after Asian Games gold and four other medals
en.dek: Mixed-doubles pair Tang Ming-wai and Lee Ka-yee said they had not expected an all-Hong Kong final in Nagoya.

zh.headline: 壁球代表隊返港 混雙金牌組合稱未敢期望太多
zh.dek: 港台報道，名古屋亞運奪得一金兩銀兩銅的壁球隊周六晚返抵香港，鄧銘漮、李嘉兒指決賽由兩對港隊包辦更值得高興。

en.headline: Hong Kong beat Cambodia 2-0 to win ASEAN Challenge Cup
en.dek: Matt Orr and an Everton Camargo penalty settled the final at Kai Tak Stadium, reports said, after a June defeat in Phnom Penh.

zh.headline: 港隊2比0挫柬埔寨 奪首屆東盟挑戰杯
zh.dek: 啟德主場決賽由安永佳先開紀錄，艾華頓十二碼建功，報導指港隊報卻6月作客敗仗。

en.headline: HKU sets 2027 non-local medicine fees at HK$590,000
en.dek: The university's admissions pages list higher non-local undergraduate rates, while a survey puts the sector average rise at 17 per cent.

zh.headline: 港大公布2027學年非本地醫科學費59萬
zh.dek: 入學處網頁列出非本地本科新學費，報章調查指八大中七校平均加幅約一成七。

en.headline: Buildings Department finds One Stanley reinforcement does not match plans
en.dek: Inspectors say a beam cover and some floor slabs at a Stanley house do not follow approved drawings, though they see no obvious danger.

zh.headline: 屋宇署：赤柱One Stanley獨立屋鋼筋配置不符圖則
zh.dek: 署方指地面低層一條橫樑保護層未按圖則配鋼絲網，部分樓板鋼筋亦與圖則不符，但未構成明顯危險。

en.headline: Hong Kong men win Asian Games sevens gold, women take bronze
en.dek: RTHK said the men beat the national team 26-0 in Nagoya to complete a third straight title, taking the gold count to 11.

zh.headline: 男子七欖亞運三連冠 女子隊再奪銅牌
zh.dek: 港台報道，港隊在名古屋決賽以26比0擊敗國家隊，完成三連冠，今屆金牌增至11面。

en.headline: Police arrest six over 25 burglaries worth HK$3.69 million
en.dek: Officers said a two-way permit couple are accused of arranging illegal entrants to break into village houses in several districts.

zh.headline: 警方拘6人 涉25宗爆竊損失逾369萬元
zh.dek: 警方指一對持雙程證夫婦涉嫌安排非法入境者，到多區村屋爆竊，不排除再有人被捕。

en.headline: Girl, 9, in critical condition with influenza B complications
en.dek: The Centre for Health Protection said the child, who has a long-term illness, developed septic shock and severe pneumonia and had not had this season's flu vaccine.

zh.headline: 9歲女童染乙型流感併發肺炎 情況危殆
zh.dek: 衞生防護中心表示，該名有長期病患的女童出現敗血性休克及嚴重肺炎，尚未接種本季流感疫苗。

en.headline: Golden Week day three passes 638,000 crossings by 4pm
en.dek: The Immigration Department said more than 190,000 of the inbound trips were by mainland visitors, mostly through Lok Ma Chau Spur Line.

zh.headline: 黃金周第三天截至下午4時逾63.8萬人次出入境
zh.dek: 入境處向港台表示，入境人次中超過19萬為內地旅客，最多經落馬洲支線管制站入境。

en.headline: Chan welcomes return of 11 Skies to the Airport Authority
en.dek: The transport chief said on Saturday the authority would rename and reposition the airport commercial project after New World hands it back next April.

zh.headline: 陳美寶樂見11 SKIES交還機管局 將重新定位
zh.dek: 運輸及物流局局長周六表示，新世界明年四月把機場商業項目交還機管局後，當局會重新命名及定位，朝高階旅遊地標發展。

en.headline: Hong Kong sailing day takes Asian Games gold tally to 10
en.dek: Youth windsurfers added two golds in Nagoya on Saturday, while ILCA 4 sailors took a silver and a bronze as the fleet finished its events.

zh.headline: 亞運帆船滑浪風帆再添獎牌 港隊金牌增至十面
zh.dek: 名古屋亞運周六帆船及滑浪風帆收科，青年滑浪風帆連添兩金，青少年單人艇再取一銀一銅，金牌總數增至十面。

en.headline: Cha Kwo Ling bing sutt to close on Monday
en.dek: Wing Wah Bing Sutt, open in the village since 1962, is due to shut on 5 October as Cha Kwo Ling is cleared for redevelopment.

zh.headline: 茶果嶺榮華冰室周一結業
zh.dek: 油塘茶果嶺村1962年開業的榮華冰室定於10月5日結業，周六已有食客排隊告別，村屋清拆重建在即。

en.headline: Woman dies after fall at Tuen Mun estate
en.dek: Police said a 26-year-old woman was found unconscious in a light well at Chelsea Heights on Saturday morning and later died in hospital.

zh.headline: 屯門卓爾居女子墮樓不治
zh.dek: 警方表示，周六早上屯門石排頭徑卓爾居一名26歲女子倒臥天井，送院後不治，案件列作從高處墮下。

en.headline: Chan urges Airport Authority to recast 11 Skies as tourism landmark
en.dek: The transport secretary said the mega complex should be upgraded for transit passengers after New World returns it next April.

zh.headline: 陳美寶促機管局盡快為11 SKIES定路向
zh.dek: 運輸及物流局局長指，新世界明年4月交還項目後，應升級為配合過境旅客的高階旅遊設施。

en.headline: Hong Kong men reach Asian Games sevens final against China
en.dek: The defending champions beat South Korea 35-14 in the semi-final; the women will play Thailand for bronze, RTHK said.

zh.headline: 港隊男子七人欖球晉亞運決賽 將戰國家隊
zh.dek: 港台報道，衛冤的港隊在四強以35比14勝韓國；女子隊準決賽不敵日本，將與泰國爭銅牌。

en.headline: Windsurfers take two golds as Hong Kong reaches 10 Asian Games titles
en.dek: Wong Tsz-ho and Cheung Tsz-yuet won the youth iQFOiL events in Nagoya, taking the gold count to 10, RTHK reported.

zh.headline: 滑浪風帆青年組連奪兩金 港隊亞運金牌增至十面
zh.dek: 港台報道，黃梓豪及張子悅在名古屋分別奪得男女子青少年水翼帆板金牌，馬君正摘女子銀牌。

en.headline: West Kowloon picnic market runs until 9pm through Sunday
en.dek: The West Kowloon Cultural District says the Art Park harbour lawn market is open 2pm to 9pm on the Golden Week weekend.

zh.headline: 西九野餐市集黃金周周末開至晚上9時
zh.dek: 西九文化區表示，藝術公園海濱草坪市集10月1日至4日舉行，周六及周日由下午2時至晚上9時。

en.headline: About 73,000 subdivided units have applied for registration
en.dek: The housing secretary said 42 units had completed certification, and 528 light-public-housing households had been allocated public rental flats.

zh.headline: 約7.3萬個分間單位已申請登記
zh.dek: 房屋局局長何永賢表示，42個單位已完成認證，528戶簡約公屋住戶已獲編配公屋。

en.headline: Free harbour shows open the performing arts expo next week
en.dek: The Hong Kong Arts Development Council said outdoor performances will run at the Cultural Centre from 6 to 9 October, ahead of the expo.

zh.headline: 演藝博覽序幕 文化中心下周二起免費演出
zh.dek: 藝發局表示，10月6日至9日每天下午4時半至7時半，在香港文化中心露天廣場有免費戶外節目。

en.headline: Woman dies after being pulled from harbour off Tsim Sha Tsui
en.dek: Police said a woman of about 30 was found in the water near K11 on Saturday morning and was pronounced dead at Queen Elizabeth Hospital.

zh.headline: 尖沙咀海傍女子被救起後不治
zh.dek: 警方指一名約30歲女子周六清晨在K11對開海面被發現，送伊利沙伯醫院後於早上7時31分證實死亡。

en.headline: Driver trapped after truck hits traffic light in Tuen Mun
en.dek: A 16-tonne goods vehicle struck a traffic light at Tsing Wun Road and Pui To Road; the driver was conscious with a head injury.

zh.headline: 屯門貨車撼交通燈 司機一度被困送院
zh.dek: 一輛16噸貨車周六早上在青雲路與杯渡路交界失事，司機頭部受傷、清醒送屯門醫院。

en.headline: Wong takes Hong Kong's first Asian Games men's singles tennis gold
en.dek: Coleman Wong beat Wu Yibing 6-2, 6-4 in Nagoya for the team's eighth gold of the Games, matching the previous edition.

zh.headline: 黃澤林奪港隊首面亞運網球男單金牌
zh.dek: 黃澤林在名古屋決賽以6比2、6比4擊敗吳易昺，港隊今屆第八金，追平上屆金牌數目。

en.headline: Observatory cancels amber rainstorm warning at 9:10am
en.dek: The signal, in force since 4am, was lifted after heavy rain over Sai Kung and Lantau; no warning is now in force.

zh.headline: 天文台上午9時10分取消黃色暴雨警告
zh.dek: 警告自凌晨4時生效，西貢及大嶼山雨勢較大；上午稍後本港已再無天氣警告生效。

en.headline: Hong Kong face Cambodia in ASEAN Challenge Cup final
en.dek: The first Challenge Cup final is this evening at Kai Tak Stadium, with FIFA president Infantino expected to attend.

zh.headline: 東盟挑戰盃決賽今晚啟德上演 港隊迎戰柬埔寨
zh.dek: 首屆決賽在啟德主場館舉行，港台報道晚上6時開賽；國際足協會長恩芬天奴預料入場觀賽並頒獎。

en.headline: Car overturns on Lung Cheung Road flyover near Choi Hung
en.dek: A driver was briefly trapped after the car flipped near Choi Hung Estate; the Tsuen Wan-bound flyover was closed.

zh.headline: 龍翔道近彩虹邨私家車撞壆翻側 往荃灣全線封閉
zh.dek: 女司機一度被困，在場接受治理；運輸署指往荃灣方向天橋全線封閉，現場擠塞。

en.headline: Vehicles collide in Eastern Harbour Crossing overnight
en.dek: Police are investigating a crash in the Hong Kong-bound tube during single-tube running; injury accounts differ.

zh.headline: 東隧單管雙程行車期間多車相撞
zh.dek: 警方正調查周六凌晨往港島管道車禍，各報道對傷者人數說法不一。

en.headline: Coffee fair at The Mills runs through Sunday
en.dek: The Urban Brew Summit's second weekend brings Japanese and local roasters to Tsuen Wan until Sunday evening.

zh.headline: 南豐紗廠咖啡節展至周日
zh.dek: Urban Brew Summit 第二個周末在荃灣舉行，周日晚上8時半結束。

en.headline: Worker dies two weeks after Tai Kok Tsui tank fall
en.dek: A 62-year-old man died on Friday morning after falling at The Long Beach on 17 September.

zh.headline: 大角咀男工維修水箱墮下 留醫兩周後不治
zh.dek: 62歲男工9月17日在瓏璽墮下約3米，周五清晨於伊利沙伯醫院證實死亡。

en.headline: Observatory extends thunderstorm warning to 10:30am
en.dek: The amber rainstorm signal remains in force as Sai Kung and Lantau record more than 70 millimetres.

zh.headline: 天文台把雷暴警告延長至上午10時30分
zh.dek: 黃色暴雨警告仍然生效，西貢及大嶼山今早雨量超過70毫米。

en.headline: Observatory issues amber rainstorm warning before dawn
en.dek: An amber rainstorm warning has been in force since 4am Saturday, with the Observatory warning of possible severe flooding in Sai Kung and on Lantau.

zh.headline: 天文台凌晨四時發出黃色暴雨警告
zh.dek: 黃色暴雨警告自周六凌晨四時生效，天文台指西貢及大嶼山雨勢特別大，可能出現嚴重水浸。

en.headline: Police log 29,670 fraud cases in first eight months
en.dek: Losses reached HK$5.21 billion, up 3.8% on last year, as police warned of new fake customer-service tactics.

zh.headline: 首八個月錄得近三萬宗詐騙案 損失52.1億元
zh.dek: 警方指今年首八個月詐騙案較去年同期升4.5%，假冒客服手法近期明顯增加，並出現新變種。

en.headline: Golden Week day two sees 954,000 crossings by 9pm
en.dek: The Immigration Department said more than 954,000 people crossed Hong Kong's control points by 9pm on Friday, the second day of the mainland holiday.

zh.headline: 黃金周次日晚上九時 出入境逾95萬人次
zh.dek: 入境處表示，周五晚上九時前全港管制站錄得超過95萬4千人次出入境，內地旅客最多經高鐵西九龍站入境。

en.headline: Centre reports one imported chikungunya case
en.dek: A 62-year-old woman who visited Guangdong is in a stable condition, the Centre for Health Protection said on Friday.

zh.headline: 防護中心公布一宗外地傳入基孔肯雅熱
zh.dek: 衛生防護中心周五表示，一名曾到廣東省的62歲女子確診基孔肯雅熱，目前情況穩定。

en.headline: Wong Tai Sin lantern display runs through Sunday
en.dek: Sik Sik Yuen is keeping the temple open later until 4 October for a free Mid-Autumn lantern display marking its 105th anniversary.

zh.headline: 黃大仙祠中秋綵燈展延至周日
zh.dek: 嗇色園黃大仙祠中秋綵燈晚會免費入場，周六及周日延長開放至晚上十時，展期至十月四日。

en.headline: National Day half-price cinema scheme drew 153,000
en.dek: The Hong Kong Theatres Association said 52 cinemas screened 1,789 shows of 62 films under the 1 October offer.

zh.headline: 國慶半價睇戲吸引逾15.3萬人次
zh.dek: 香港戲院商會指全港52間戲院參與，當日放映1,789場、62套電影，多區場次爆滿。

en.headline: MTR to pay government HK$2.25 billion over rail delay
en.dek: The one-off settlement covers the late high-speed rail link; both sides agreed not to pursue further claims on the Sha Tin to Central Link.

zh.headline: 港鐵就高鐵延誤向政府支付22.5億元
zh.dek: 政府與港鐵周五達成解決安排，沙中綫則因公司已承擔約28億元額外開支，雙方同意互不追討。

en.headline: Thunderstorm warning carried into early Saturday
en.dek: The Observatory's 2am bulletin kept the warning in force until 3am, with isolated storms and heavy pockets of rain.

zh.headline: 雷暴警告延至周六凌晨生效
zh.dek: 天文台凌晨2時天氣報告指警告有效至上午3時，本港局部地區仍有雷暴，沙田錄得較大雨量。

en.headline: Motorcyclist dies after Pok Fu Lam crash; driver arrested
en.dek: Police said a 63-year-old rider died in hospital on Friday morning after a Thursday-night collision on Victoria Road.

zh.headline: 薄扶林車禍鐵騎士不治 休班輔警涉危駕被捕
zh.dek: 警方指63歲電單車司機周四晚在域多利道近摩星嶺徑相撞後，周五早上在瑪麗醫院證實死亡。

en.headline: Hung Hom drone show goes ahead after weather delay
en.dek: The first of two National Day drone flights at the Hung Hom promenade was cancelled; the second display went ahead.

zh.headline: 紅磡無人機匯演次場照演　首場因天氣取消
zh.dek: 國慶無人機表演原定紅磡新海濱兩場，港台報道首場因天氣取消，第二場順利舉行。

en.headline: Off-duty ambulance officer dies after Kowloon Peak fall
en.dek: Fire Services says one of two off-duty ambulance officers died after a fall while abseiling; his colleague was lightly injured.

zh.headline: 飛鵝山墮崖　休班救護總隊目送院不治
zh.dek: 消防處說，兩名休班救護總隊目在飛鵝山遊繩期間一人墮崖，送東區醫院後證實不治，同行者受輕傷。

en.headline: Tang writes to New York Times over arrest article
en.dek: The security secretary said a report on a recent arrest distorted the facts and was unrelated to press freedom.

zh.headline: 鄧炳強去信《紐約時報》反對拘捕報道
zh.dek: 保安局局長指有關本港近日拘捕的報道歪曲事實，並強調案件與新聞自由無關。

en.headline: Observatory cancels amber rainstorm warning at 7:30pm
en.dek: The amber signal is down, but a thunderstorm warning runs until 9pm and Tai Po remains under a flooding alert.

zh.headline: 天文台晚上7時30分取消黃色暴雨警告
zh.dek: 黃雨信號已經取消，雷暴警告維持至晚上9時，大埔仍有水浸特別提示。

en.headline: Customs arrest yoga centre director over alleged wrongful payment
en.dek: One company director was arrested on Friday as Hotstone Yoga complaints rose to 286, involving more than HK$3.9 million.

zh.headline: 海關拘捕瑜伽中心一名公司董事　疑不當地接受付款
zh.dek: 岩盤浴瑜伽全線結業後，海關星期五拘捕一名公司董事，消委會接獲286宗投訴，涉款逾390萬元。

en.headline: Unconscious climber airlifted after Kowloon Peak fall
en.dek: Firefighters found the man in heavy rain on Friday evening and flew him to Eastern Hospital; his companion was also injured.

zh.headline: 飛鵝山攀石男子昏迷　直升機送東區醫院
zh.dek: 消防員星期五傍晚在大雨中尋獲墮崖男子，他送院時昏迷，同行男子亦受傷。

en.headline: Observatory issues amber rainstorm warning as northern downpours continue
en.dek: The amber signal went up at 5:40pm, with the northern New Territories flooding announcement and the afternoon thunderstorm warning still in force.

zh.headline: 天文台發出黃色暴雨警告 新界北部大雨持續
zh.dek: 黃色暴雨警告於下午5時40分生效，新界北部水浸特別報告及下午的雷暴警告仍然有效。

en.headline: August retail sales rise 5.6% to HK$32.1 billion
en.dek: The Census and Statistics Department said the gain was the 16th straight monthly increase, with online sales up 9.9%.

zh.headline: 八月零售銷貨價值升5.6% 至321億元
zh.dek: 政府統計處公布臨時數字，按年升幅為連續第16個月擴張，網上銷售升9.9%。

en.headline: Hang Seng closes down 640 points, back under 24,000
en.dek: The index finished at 23,972 after a holiday-delayed session, with AIA, Standard Chartered and HSBC leading the fall.

zh.headline: 恒指收市跌640點 失守二萬四
zh.dek: 假期後首個交易日恒指收報23972點，友邦、渣打及滙控領跌，全日成交1458億元。

en.headline: Clara Chan reappointed Hong Kong Investment Corporation chief for three years
en.dek: Financial Secretary Paul Chan said the board had renewed her term from 9 October, citing patient capital and reasonable returns.

zh.headline: 陳家齊再任港投公司行政總裁 任期三年
zh.dek: 財政司司長陳茂波宣布董事會再度委任陳家齊，新任期於10月9日生效，並指投資取得合理回報。

en.headline: Rescuers search Kowloon Peak after climber falls
en.dek: Police were told shortly after 2:30pm that a man had fallen while climbing with a colleague near Suicide Cliff. Fire crews and a helicopter were sent.

zh.headline: 飛鵝山攀石男墮下 消防及飛行服務隊搜救
zh.dek: 警方下午約2時半接報，一名男子與同事在自殺崖一帶攀石時墮下，救援人員正登山施救。

en.headline: Hong Kong women take Asian Games squash team silver
en.dek: The side lost the Nagoya final 1-2 to Malaysia after Chan Sin-yuk levelled the tie.

zh.headline: 亞運壁球女團決賽負馬來西亞 港隊摘銀
zh.dek: 港隊在名古屋決賽以場數1比2落敗，陳善鈺先扳平場數，李嘉兒第三場直落落敗。

en.headline: Helper minimum wage set at HK$5,220 for new contracts
en.dek: The government guide says the rate applies to contracts signed from 3 October. The food allowance stays at HK$1,236.

zh.headline: 外傭規定最低工資調至5220元 明日起新約適用
zh.dek: 政府指引列明，每月5220元適用於10月3日或以後簽訂的合約，膳食津貼維持不少於1236元。

en.headline: Observatory warns of flooding risk around Sheung Shui
en.dek: A 5pm announcement said more than 70 millimetres of rain fell in an hour in the northern New Territories.

zh.headline: 天文台發新界北部水浸特別報告 上水雨勢較大
zh.dek: 下午5時的特別報告指新界北過去一小時錄得超過70毫米雨量，上水一帶尤其明顯。

en.headline: Observatory extends afternoon thunderstorm warning to 6:30pm
en.dek: A warning issued at 3:55pm was kept in force until 6:30pm, with isolated storms expected over Hong Kong.

zh.headline: 天文台下午雷暴警告延長至6時30分
zh.dek: 下午3時55分發出的雷暴警告延長至下午6時30分，預料本港有局部地區雷暴。

en.headline: 90.4% of Wang Fuk Court owners have signed sale agreements
en.dek: Housing secretary Winnie Ho said the figure was as of 30 September, with signing due by 15 October.

zh.headline: 截至9月30日 宏福苑90.4%業主已簽買賣協議
zh.dek: 房屋局局長何永賢表示，業主須於10月15日或之前完成簽署，解說專隊會繼續支援揀樓。

en.headline: Hong Kong takes two sailing golds in youth 29er events
en.dek: The men's and women's youth 29er crews both won in Nagoya, a day that also included an ILCA 7 silver.

zh.headline: 亞運帆船青年29人級港隊再奪兩金
zh.dek: 男女子青年快速艇29人級均稱冠，連同ILCA 7銀牌，帆船隊單日兩金一銀。

en.headline: Golden Week day one sees 1.08 million border crossings
en.dek: Immigration figures for Thursday show more than 590,000 arrivals, including about 277,000 mainland visitors.

zh.headline: 黃金周首日進出境約108萬人次
zh.dek: 入境處周五公布周四全日數字，入境逾59萬人次，當中內地旅客約27萬7千。

en.headline: Hung Shing Temple and Stanley Mosque declared monuments
en.dek: The Development Bureau gazetted the Wan Chai temple and the mosque inside Stanley Prison as statutory monuments on Friday.

zh.headline: 灣仔洪聖古廟及赤柱清真寺列法定古蹟
zh.dek: 發展局周五刊憲，古物事務監督根據《古物及古蹟條例》宣布兩座建築列為法定古蹟。

en.headline: Customs seize cigarettes worth HK$1.88 million at Man Kam To
en.dek: Officers found about 360,000 suspected illicit cigarettes mixed with vegetables on an inbound truck and arrested the driver.

zh.headline: 海關文錦渡檢約36萬支懷疑私煙
zh.dek: 入境運菜貨車的63個發泡膠箱混有懷疑私煙，市值約188萬元，司機被捕保釋。

en.headline: Observatory extends thunderstorm warning until 2:30pm
en.dek: The warning first issued at 11:50am was kept in force for another hour, covering isolated storms over the northern New Territories.

zh.headline: 天文台延長雷暴警告至下午2時30分
zh.dek: 上午11時50分發出的雷暴警告再延長一小時，預料新界北有局部雷暴。

en.headline: Showers linger this weekend before a cooler Monday
en.dek: The Observatory expects cloudy spells and showers on Saturday and Sunday, then a fresher northeast monsoon from Sunday night.

zh.headline: 周末仍有驟雨 周一早上稍涼
zh.dek: 天文台預料周六日大致多雲有驟雨，周日晚東北季候風補充，隨後轉涼及雨勢減弱。

en.headline: Pui takes Asian Games silver in men's ILCA 7 sailing
en.dek: Pui Chun-lung finished second in the men's ILCA 7, two points behind the Korean winner, RTHK reported.

zh.headline: 貝俊龍亞運男子ILCA 7帆船摘銀
zh.dek: 港隊貝俊龍在名古屋亞運男子單人艇ILCA 7以11分位列第二，落後韓國選手兩分奪銀。

en.headline: Ho Man Tin luxury site draws at least 10 bids at noon close
en.dek: The Fat Kwong Street residential site closed at noon with at least 10 tenders, including bids from major developers, reports said.

zh.headline: 何文田佛光街住宅地中午截標 最少10份標書
zh.dek: 何文田佛光街私人住宅用地中午截標，現場最少收到10份標書，多間大型發展商入標。

en.headline: Observatory issues thunderstorm warning valid until 1:30pm
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory warned of isolated thunderstorms until 1:30pm, with heavier showers expected in some districts over the next hour or two.

zh.headline: 天文台發出雷暴警告 有效至下午1時30分
zh.dek: 天文台警告本港有局部雷暴，有效至下午1時30分，並指未來一兩小時部分地區雨勢可能較大。

en.headline: Wong reaches Asian Games men's singles tennis final
en.dek: Coleman Wong beat Uzbekistan's Sultanov to reach the final and is assured of at least silver, RTHK reported.

zh.headline: 黃澤林闖亞運網球男單決賽 最少奪銀
zh.dek: 港隊黃澤林擊敗烏茲別克球手蘇丹諾夫晉身決賽，香港電台指他坐銀望金。

en.headline: Hang Seng down 2.6% by late morning after holiday break
en.dek: The benchmark stood at 23,975.90 at 11:05am, down 637 points from Wednesday's close, after opening 513 points lower.

zh.headline: 國慶假期後復市 恒指上午跌逾六百點
zh.dek: 恒指上午11時05分報23975點，較周三收市跌637點；今早低開513點，盤中曾低見23865點。

en.headline: HKEX chief says investors want more than equities
en.dek: Bonnie Chan told RTHK that Hong Kong should build a broader asset ecosystem, citing stronger turnover and renewed interest in gold futures.

zh.headline: 陳翊庭：港股以外也要建多元資產生態圈
zh.dek: 港交所行政總裁在港台節目表示，投資者希望配置股票以外的資產，並提到成交回升及美元黃金期貨反應。

en.headline: M+ stays open until 10pm today for Golden Week
en.dek: West Kowloon says M+ and the Palace Museum will keep extended hours through 7 October, and asks visitors to book ahead.

zh.headline: 黃金周西九兩館延長開放 M+今晚十時閉館
zh.dek: 西九文化區表示，M+及故宮文化博物館在國慶黃金周維持延長開放，並建議訪客預先購票。

en.headline: Fixed-rate mortgages take 37.4% of new loans, an eight-year high
en.dek: The Monetary Authority's August survey shows fixed-rate plans rising for a 12th month, while newly approved mortgage lending fell to HK$32.2 billion.

zh.headline: 八月定息按揭佔新批貸款37.4% 創逾八年高
zh.dek: 金管局調查顯示，定息按揭佔比連升十二個月；新批住宅按揭貸款額跌至322億元。

en.headline: Tai Kwun film exhibition closes on Sunday
en.dek: Better Together, on Hong Kong cinema's team spirit, runs at Tai Kwun's Duplex Studio until 4 October, with tickets at HK$30.

zh.headline: 大館香港電影展覽周日結束
zh.dek: 「拍住上」展覽在中環荷李活道十號大館一號館複式展室展至十月四日，普通票三十元。

en.headline: FEHD prosecutes Telford Plaza restaurant after rodent complaint
en.dek: Inspectors found poor hygiene at the Kowloon Bay restaurant and issued a rodent notice, as a two-week food-premises sweep begins.

zh.headline: 食環署巡查德福廣場食肆後提出檢控
zh.dek: 署方指九龍灣該食肆衛生欠佳，已發消除蟲鼠通知，並展開為期兩星期的天羅行動。

en.headline: Three substances to be listed under Dangerous Drugs Ordinance
en.dek: The Security Bureau said the amending order would be gazetted on Friday, tabled in LegCo on 7 October and take effect on 27 November.

zh.headline: 三款物質納入危險藥物條例 周五刊憲
zh.dek: 保安局表示修訂令周五刊登憲報，十月七日提交立法會先訂立後審議，預計十一月二十七日生效。

en.headline: Neon archive show at Blue Lotus closes on Sunday
en.dek: Keith Macgregor's City of Lights runs at the Sheung Wan gallery through 4 October, documenting Hong Kong neon from the 1990s and 2000s.

zh.headline: 上環藍蓮畫廊霓虹攝影展周日結束
zh.dek: 攝影師Keith Macgregor的City of Lights在太平山街磅巷展至十月四日，記錄九十及二千年代香港霓虹。

en.headline: Observatory issues morning thunderstorm warning for New Territories
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the warning at 6:10am, valid until 8:30am, for isolated storms over the New Territories.

zh.headline: 天文台早上發出雷暴警告 新界局部有雷暴
zh.dek: 天文台上午6時10分發出雷暴警告，有效至上午8時30分，預料新界有局部地區雷暴。

en.headline: Chu takes omnium silver as sailors medal in Nagoya
en.dek: Chu Tsun-wai scored 166 points for men's omnium silver, while Hong Kong also took silver and bronze in the skiff events on Thursday.

zh.headline: 朱浚瑋全能賽摘銀 帆船再添一銀一銅
zh.dek: 朱浚瑋在名古屋亞運男子全能賽以166分奪銀；女子49erFX得銀，男子49er得銅。

en.headline: Man dies after rescue off Hung Hom promenade
en.dek: Firefighters pulled an unconscious man from the water off Kin Wan Street on Thursday night; he was later confirmed dead at Queen Elizabeth Hospital.

zh.headline: 紅磡海濱男子墮海 送院後不治
zh.dek: 周四晚上約九時二十一分，建灣街海濱長廊對開有男子墮海，消防救起時已昏迷，送伊利沙伯醫院後證實不治。

en.headline: Victoria Park lantern show stays lit through Golden Week
en.dek: The Tourism Board's International Lantern Spectacular at Victoria Park runs until 7 October, with free entry and lights from 6:30pm to 11pm.

zh.headline: 維園國際彩燈展延至十月七日 黃金周繼續亮燈
zh.dek: 旅發局的國際彩燈匯在銅鑼灣維多利亞公園展出至十月七日，免費入場，每晚六時半至十一時亮燈。

en.headline: More than half of Po Pin Chau bookings unused on National Day
en.dek: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department said about 1,160 people arrived on Thursday against roughly 2,420 bookings, and released slots on the day.

zh.headline: 國慶日破邊洲逾半預約未到 漁護署即場放額
zh.dek: 漁護署表示，周四約有2420人預約破邊洲段，實際到訪約1160人，包括即場放額後補上的遊人。

en.headline: Nearly 270,000 mainland visitors entered by 9pm on day one
en.dek: Immigration officers recorded more than 897,000 cross-boundary movements by 9pm on Thursday, with most mainland arrivals using Lok Ma Chau Spur Line.

zh.headline: 黃金周首日晚上九時近27萬內地旅客入境
zh.dek: 入境處表示，截至星期四晚上九時，各管制站錄得逾89.7萬人次出入境，內地旅客入境近27萬，以落馬洲支線最多。

en.headline: Italian gelato market runs at PMQ through the holiday weekend
en.dek: Ciao! Gelato Fest is at PMQ in Central from 1 to 4 October, with a second weekend listed for 9 to 11 October and free entry.

zh.headline: 意式雪糕市集假期在中環元創方舉行
zh.dek: 「Ciao! Gelato Fest」十月一日至四日在中環元創方舉行，主辦方另列十月九日至十一日為第二個週末，入場免費。

en.headline: Thunderstorm warning lapses after overnight extension
en.dek: The Observatory's thunderstorm warning, extended until 1am, is no longer in force, while the very hot weather and yellow fire danger warnings remain.

zh.headline: 雷暴警告延長至凌晨一時後不再生效
zh.dek: 天文台昨晚把雷暴警告延長至凌晨一時，現時已不再列為生效；酷熱天氣警告及黃色火災危險警告仍然有效。

en.headline: Police say about 380,000 watched National Day fireworks
en.dek: Officers put the Victoria Harbour crowd at about 380,000 after the 23-minute display, above the earlier estimate of 260,000.

zh.headline: 警方稱約38萬人觀賞國慶煙花匯演
zh.dek: 煙花匯演結束後，警方表示約有38萬人在維港兩岸觀賞，高於事前預估26萬人。

en.headline: Observatory issues thunderstorm warning for eastern New Territories
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory raised a thunderstorm warning at 9:30pm, valid until 11:30pm, for isolated storms in the eastern New Territories.

zh.headline: 天文台發出雷暴警告 預料新界東部有局部雷暴
zh.dek: 天文台晚上9時30分發出雷暴警告，有效至晚上11時30分，預料新界東部有局部地區雷暴。

en.headline: Observatory expects showers as monsoon nears after hot day
en.dek: The 6.30pm bulletin said temperatures topped 34 degrees in many places, with showers and thunderstorms overnight and a high of about 31 on Friday.

zh.headline: 天文台料今晚有驟雨 東北季候風明日起影響
zh.dek: 晚上6時30分報告指多處下午高見34度，今晚及明日有驟雨及雷暴，明日氣溫約27至31度。

en.headline: National Day fireworks display held over Victoria Harbour
en.dek: The 23-minute show began at 8pm with 31,888 shells, as police had expected about 260,000 people on both sides of the harbour.

zh.headline: 國慶煙花匯演維港上演 歷時約23分鐘
zh.dek: 煙花晚上8時開始，發放31,888枚煙花；警方預計約26萬人在兩岸觀賞。

en.headline: Customs probe Hotstone Yoga closure as complaints hit 27
en.dek: The Consumer Council said it had taken 27 complaints worth HK$429,326 by 5pm, while Customs posted an investigation notice at the Jordan studio.

zh.headline: 海關調查Hotstone Yoga結業 消委會接27宗投訴
zh.dek: 消委會表示截至下午5時接27宗投訴，涉款429,326元；海關在佐敦分店外張貼調查告示。
